title: Ultrasound and microbubble-mediated delivery of miR-424-5p in preeclampsia
author: Wang, Wu, et al.
materials: miR-424-5p mimic (50 nM), vectors with AOC1 overexpression (2 μg), and the corresponding negative controls (mimic NC and pcDNA3.1) were synthesized by Shanghai GenePharma Co.,Ltd (Shanghai, China) and transfected into cells as the instructions on Lipofectamine 2000 reagent (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA, USA). Following measurements were carried out 48 h after the transfections.

steps.title: Maintain trophoblast and HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Culture HTR-8/Svneo and TEV-1 cells in DMEM/F12 (Gibco) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS); culture HEK293T cells in DMEM (Gibco) supplemented with 10 % FBS and 1 % penicillin/streptomycin. Incubate all cells at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Transfect cells with miR‑424‑5p or AOC1
steps.instruction: Prepare transfection mixes using Lipofectamine 2000 (Invitrogen) according to the manufacturer’s protocol: add miR‑424‑5p mimic to a final concentration of 50 nM, add AOC1 overexpression plasmid (pcDNA3.1‑AOC1) at 2 µg per well, and include the corresponding negative controls (mimic NC and empty pcDNA3.1). After transfection, incubate cells for 48 h before downstream measurements.

steps.title: Prepare perfluoropropane microbubbles
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube add 5 mg distearoyl phosphatidylcholine, 2 mg dipalmitoyl phosphatidylethanolamine, 2 mg EGFP‑miR‑424‑5p plasmid (Genepharma), 1 mg Span 60, and 50 µl glycerinum. Add PBS and bring the total volume to 0.5 ml. Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 min. Replace the air in the tube with perfluoropropane gas, shake vigorously for 60 s, then add an additional 0.5 ml PBS and let stand for 5 min. Disinfect the tube and store the microbubble suspension at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Treat cells with microbubbles and ultrasound
steps.instruction: Add the prepared microbubble suspension to HTR‑8/Svneo or TEV‑1 cells (final microbubble concentration ≤10 % v/v as determined by prior toxicity testing). Expose the cell‑microbubble mixture to ultrasound at 300 kHz and 0.5 W / cm² for 30 s.

steps.title: Perform apoptosis assay by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Adjust cell density to 1 × 10⁵ cells / ml, pipette 3 ml into a 10 ml centrifuge tube and centrifuge 5 min at 500 rpm. Remove supernatant, wash cells with PBS, and centrifuge again 5 min at 500 rpm. Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 µl binding buffer. Add 5 µl Annexin V‑FITC and 5 µl propidium iodide (PI), incubate 5 min at room temperature in the dark. Analyze fluorescence by flow cytometry to quantify apoptotic cells.

steps.title: Stain placental sections with H&E
steps.instruction: Fix collected placental tissue in 4 % paraformaldehyde, embed in paraffin and cut 4‑µm sections. Dewax sections in xylene, rehydrate through a graded ethanol series, stain with hematoxylin for 5 min, dip in 1 % hydrochloric acid alcohol for 30 s, then stain with eosin for 2 min. Dehydrate, clear, mount with a coverslip, and examine under a microscope.
